name: base_utils
description: Manages common operating-system utilities, including an optional MOTD and a Hiera-configured package list, along with custom facts, functions, types, plans, and service-check support.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys and configures a full Python application stack, including dependencies, application source, PostgreSQL connectivity and migrations, environment settings, systemd service management, monitoring, and log rotation.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures an HAProxy load balancer with generated backend configuration, optional discovery, health checks, service management, firewall rules, statistics, logging, TLS settings, and custom error pages.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL using a PGDG repository, version-pinned packages, and managed service enablement.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis with cluster-member discovery through PuppetDB, including configurable port, password, memory limit, eviction policy, and service settings.
